scientific_integrity: The uniform integral module theorem follows from a natural exact Mayer–Vietoris connecting map. All finite representation checks were reproduced from a standalone program. The historical nonequivariant homotopy computation is prior work, not new.
scientific_limitations: The exact group-character distribution and polarity-lattice refinement are computed only for the Fano plane. The general theorem applies to any existing finite projective plane. No independent audit was performed; unindexed equivariant treatments might overlap.
title: Integral duality-twisted homology of projective-plane graph-power complexes
